activity_summary: At rehearsal the K was still only a letter. Kemp was sharp and still said you. You asked again for a line, not a number, and you did not get one. Burbage called for the Errors cues. The Rose had a Siege of London. You did not go to read the bill, and you did not cross. Phillips kept the songs as they were and did not fetch Nick. You did not move a third stop. Kemp kept the watchet gown out of the room. Nothing was bought.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused a figure, kept Nick's speech unspent, and stayed with Egeon.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Stayed on you, refused to name a line, and kept the gown out of the room.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Showed the K unchanged and named the Rose's title without a receipt.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Called for the old Errors cues.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Held the songs and left Nick unfetched.

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: The K is where I left it.

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: You, Will. I am still saying you.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not going to read their bill in the street.
